canonical_public_artifacts.training_provenance: Sparse GEFF centroids rendered as Gaussian center heatmaps with a positive-unlabeled weighted BCE objective and a fixed random 10% validation split. This model is a conservative repair gate, not the selected primary detector.

pipeline_contract.input: Two consecutive 3D image frames from the same movie, read with z/y/x stride 1/4/4.
pipeline_contract.normalization: Use Zarr image_statistics quantiles 0.001 and 0.999 for the whole movie and clamp normalized values below at zero.
pipeline_contract.candidate_detection: Run the primary and secondary TemporalUNet3D branches on the same two-frame window, align and average eight D4 detection-logit views, calibrate the secondary logit scale, blend secondary detection logits with weight 0.80, and detect pooled local maxima above probability 0.965.
pipeline_contract.primary_candidate_feature: At each candidate coordinate on the downsampled grid, integer-index the 32-channel primary TemporalUNet3D output after inverse-transforming and averaging the same eight D4 feature maps.
pipeline_contract.secondary_candidate_feature: At each candidate coordinate, integer-index the 32-channel secondary TemporalUNet3D output from the original spatial view. The selected 0.946 source does not average secondary association features.
pipeline_contract.tracker_input: For each branch, concatenate its 32-channel candidate image feature with the 32-dimensional window-relative positional encoding. SimpleNodeTransformer also scores every source-target pair with the relative z/y/x displacement.
pipeline_contract.tracker_control: Use the two SimpleNodeTransformer branches embedded in the primary and secondary checkpoints, combine forward and reverse association probabilities by the notebook's harmonic mutual-support rule, retain the secondary branch only on low-margin primary agreements, and pass candidates to the existing ILP and graph-repair pipeline.
pipeline_contract.downstream_training_recommendation: Initialize the trainable primary SimpleNodeTransformer from the primary checkpoint. Freeze the primary TemporalUNet3D and detection head, the complete secondary branch, and DeepCenter. Keep the selected detector candidates, feature extraction, secondary contribution, ILP, and repair settings fixed so the first comparison changes only the primary tracker weights.
pipeline_contract.existing_tracker_loss_to_audit: The public training source applies focal-weighted binary cross entropy after a source-axis softmax on pairs touching an annotated source or target. The next experiment must audit teacher matching and the sparse-label mask before training.
pipeline_contract.decode: Use the selected notebook's edge candidate threshold, ILP, motion relinking, gap repair, division repair, short-track filtering, and DeepCenter veto unchanged for the first baseline comparison.
